newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka removes stamp duty on share transactions.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka removes stamp duty on share transactions.

text.p: Sri Lanka will remove the 0.5 percent stamp duty on share transactions to help the market to consolidate its recovery, Deputy Finance Minister G.L. Peiris told parliament on Wednesday.
"The market has climbed 67 points in the past two and a half months (to 617 points on the all share index)," Peiris told parliament as he presented the state budget for calendar 1997.
"We plan to remove stamp duty on share transactions to help the market consolidate its recovery," he said.
Peiris also said the governmment plans to make all listed company dividends tax free in the hands of shareholders to encourage companies to go public.
